summary: Arbitration agreement validity post-accord and satisfaction; discharge voucher vs arbitration clause survival; scope of judicial scrutiny under Section 11(6) Arbitration Act; stamp duty implications on arbitration agreements; negative competence-competence doctrine; consent letter and discharge voucher examined for finality of settlement; dismissal of respondent's arbitration petition upheld; execution of voucher as preclusive of arbitration claim.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgments set aside; appointment of arbitrator quashed; discharge voucher deemed valid full and final settlement.
